title: Witch in Cosmic Room
description: A young woman with short black hair kneels on a patterned rug in a cozy living room, wearing a blue ruffled outfit and thigh-high stockings while holding a black staff. Behind her, a large surreal painting dominates the wall showing a green-robed hooded figure casting blue lightning toward a glowing red and black cosmic portal with a castle.
prompt: A young woman with short black bob hair kneels on a rug in a cozy autumn living room, wearing a blue ruffled top and blue stockings, holding a black staff with both hands. Behind her on the wall is a giant surreal painting of a hooded green-robed wizard casting blue lightning toward a massive red and black cosmic black hole portal with a white castle inside it. Bookshelf, sofa, fallen autumn leaves on the floor, magical floating orbs, detailed digital painting style.
